title: Farming in boastful talk
explanation: In this source’s gloss, the expression mocks undertaking or talking about work without understanding it. The element Barabati is retained untranslated and is not independently resolved here.
meaning_odia: ଯେଉଁ କାମ ବିଷୟରେ ଜ୍ଞାନ ନାହିଁ, ସେହି କାମକୁ ନେଇ ତୁଛା କଥା ବା କାମ କରିବାକୁ ଏଠାରେ ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ କରାଯାଇଛି।
usage_example: Someone promises a complex project without knowing its basic requirements. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: No origin story is supplied. The wording alone does not establish a place or an actual farming episode.
